QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` is defined only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is set and `__GNUC__` is available (armcc5 is excluded).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined in constant_time_impl.h from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler macros (__GNUC__), not from a config entry. It never says outright that this is "derived rather than configured", but it gives the mechanism and the location.
